component.name: hktools
component.summary: Batch media processing: encode, remux, subtitles, speech recognition
Пакетная обработка медиа: кодирование, ремукс, субтитры, распознавание речи

description.p: GTK4/libadwaita front-end for ffmpeg, mkvtoolnix, yt-dlp and whisper.cpp with 18 batch tools: video encoding (NVENC, VAAPI, x265, x264, SVT-AV1), audio encoding (FDK-AAC, FLAC, Opus…), downmix, PAL/NTSC speed change, channel split, audio shift and transplant with waveform sync, MKV assembly, stream management, extraction, subtitle conversion and shift, Whisper transcription, downloads and bitrate analysis.
Independent Linux fork of K-Tools by krnzhnr (https://github.com/krnzhnr/k-tools). Not an official K-Tools release.
Early alpha of the Linux fork: GTK4 + libadwaita, Hyprland integration, VAAPI support.
